prompt: Create a premium promotional background visual for temaru, a Japanese listing tool for online resellers. Palette: deep navy, royal blue, bright sky blue, with small warm gold accents. Clean, modern, cinematic, high-end. No people, no characters, no hands. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, or readable UI labels. Product cards may show items only. Scene direction: Cinematic wide banner background. On the LEFT 40%: a large floating translucent blue-glass browser window, slightly tilted in 3D perspective, showing a neat grid of luxury fashion product cards (leather handbag, white sneakers, sunglasses, watch, scarf) each with a small green check mark, product photos look like the reference. Several product cards fly into the window from the far left along a bright cyan light trail with sparkles. The window glows with soft blue rim light. Background: night city skyline at blue hour seen from high above, glass skyscrapers, deep navy at the bottom, a bright luminous sky with soft clouds and a warm sunrise glow in the upper right, diagonal light rays and lens flare streaks. The RIGHT 60% is calmer: sky and distant buildings with gentle bokeh, good for overlaying large text. High contrast, vivid, premium advertising style.
